title: Classification Aggregation with Multiple Memberships
abstract: arXiv:2611.02984v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: People face the problem of classifying objects into categories while aggregating their opinions. We axiomatically study such a classification aggregation problem with multiple memberships, meaning that each individual assigns one category to every object, whereas the resulting classification may assign more than one category. Under the natural settings and axioms (i.e., Independence and Supportiveness), each of our new axioms -- Responsibility, Split Stability and Rejection Stability -- characterises what we call the junta rules. The rules assign a category to an object exactly when some member of a fixed coalition does so. The coalitions that can secure an assignment form a grill, a topological structure implied by an ultrafilter. Hence, the study parallels the literature on Arrow's theorem characterised by the decisive coalition structures. An infinite population setting is also investigated to clarify the differences among the axioms.

translated_title: 具有多重隶属关系的分类聚合
translated_abstract: 人们在将对象归类到不同类别的过程中需要聚合各人的意见。我们以公理化方法研究了这种允许多重隶属关系的分类聚合问题，即每个个体为每个对象只分配一个类别，而最终形成的分类结果却可能为同一对象分配多个类别。在自然的设定和公理（即独立性与支持性）之下，我们提出的每一个新公理——责任性、分裂稳定性和拒绝稳定性——都刻画了我们所称的“小集团规则”。这类规则恰好当某个固定联盟中的某一成员为对象分配某类别时，才将该类别分配给该对象。能够确保分配成立的联盟构成一个“栅格”，这是一种由超滤子所蕴含的拓扑结构。因此，本研究与以决定性联盟结构为特征的阿罗定理文献形成呼应。此外，我们还研究了无限人口的情形，以厘清各公理之间的差异。
tldr: 本文公理化研究了允许多重隶属结果的分类聚合问题，提出责任性、分裂稳定性和拒绝稳定性三个新公理，并证明它们各自刻画了“小集团规则”，其确保分配的联盟结构形成栅格，从而与阿罗定理的决定性联盟结构研究相平行。
